finding.summary: Inconsistent excluded handling: for completed reviews, excluded=[] is hardcoded, but for the all-excluded early return, the actual excluded paths are returned. Consumers may not expect this asymmetry.
finding.fix: Either always populate excluded from the review state (excluded_files in review_commit), or document that excluded is only non-empty when all files were excluded.

label: false_positive
label_reason: `excluded` is set only when every changed file is excluded (nothing reviewed, so nothing raised); a partly excluded diff reviews the rest, and the asserts never read the field.
notes: finding.line moved 56 -> 48: at raised_sha fee8a9a the hardcoded excluded=[] the finding describes is at eval_adapter.py:48 (56 is past the end of the file); the review cited the wrong line.
